nodes.label: GitHub Flow Branching Model
nodes.rationale: Single long-lived main branch protected by CI; feature/* and hotfix/* are short-lived and deleted after merge; PR merge to main is mandatory, no force push.

nodes.label: Changesets-Driven Versioning
nodes.rationale: Version numbers are never hand-written: each user-facing PR carries a .changeset/*.md declaring patch/minor/major, and pnpm changeset version computes the bump (highest level wins) at release time; version carrier is apps/server/package.json with root synced by workflow; changeset-check.yml blocks PRs lacking a changeset unless labeled no-changeset.

nodes.label: Release Process (Tag to Docker)
nodes.rationale: Manual Release workflow runs changeset version on main, commits 'chore: release X.Y.Z', tags vX.Y.Z, creates a GitHub Release; the tag push triggers ci.yml which builds and pushes ghcr.io opc-server:X.Y.Z and :latest.
